# Spaceman

> Spaceman is a tiling window manager for macOS on Apple silicon (macOS 14 or later), version 0.3.0. Windows open side by side instead of on top of each other, across ten numbered workspaces you switch with the keyboard, with ordered rules for where apps open, native-tab continuity, durable window restoration and a local CLI.

Spaceman uses macOS Accessibility APIs and needs no System Integrity Protection changes. It provides ten numbered workspaces (`1`–`10`) plus opt-in named workspaces (`A`–`Z`), nested weighted split layouts, drag-to-reorder and resize, and restores every hidden window on pause, quit or update. Window titles never leave memory, and it sends no telemetry.

## Install

- [Download for macOS](https://pub-6f85d683ffe0419cad0a71508904053a.r2.dev/releases/Spaceman-v0.3.0-macos-arm64.zip): version 0.3.0, Apple silicon, macOS 14 or later; Developer ID-signed and notarized.
- [SHA-256 checksum](https://pub-6f85d683ffe0419cad0a71508904053a.r2.dev/releases/Spaceman-v0.3.0-macos-arm64.zip.sha256): checksum for `Spaceman-v0.3.0-macos-arm64.zip`.
- Terminal: `curl -fL https://pub-6f85d683ffe0419cad0a71508904053a.r2.dev/releases/Spaceman-latest-macos-arm64.zip -o /tmp/Spaceman.zip && ditto -x -k /tmp/Spaceman.zip /Applications && open /Applications/Spaceman.app`
